check_feature_names: check and validate feature names from pandas columns or generate default x0, x1 names for numpy arrays
create_feature_names_list: create a validated list of feature names from array-like input data with duplicate detection
test_feature_names_duplicates: test that feature names list contains no duplicate entries and raises ValueError on duplicates
get_feature_index: get the integer index of a feature by name or pass through an integer index from a feature names list
review_feature_index_lookup: review the feature index lookup that converts feature names to indices with error handling for missing names
